# raqz.pl - AI & Automation Services

> Professional IT services specializing in AI automation, chatbots, dashboards, and digital solutions for businesses in the Mazury region (Poland) and beyond.

## About

raqz.pl is a technology consultancy offering AI-powered automation solutions, custom software development, and digital transformation services. We help businesses streamline operations, improve customer service, and reduce manual workload through intelligent automation.

## Services

- **AI Chatbots**: Custom conversational AI for customer support, booking, and inquiries
- **Process Automation**: Workflow automation, data processing, and integrations
- **Dashboards & Analytics**: Real-time business intelligence and reporting
- **Web Development**: Modern web applications with Next.js, React, and TypeScript
- **Blockchain Development**: Smart contracts and decentralized applications
- **AI Integrations**: OpenAI, Claude, and custom ML model integrations

## Target Audience

- Small and medium businesses in the Mazury region (Mikołajki, Giżycko, Mrągowo, Olsztyn)
- Tourism and hospitality businesses (hotels, guesthouses, restaurants)
- Companies seeking digital transformation and automation
- Businesses looking for local IT expertise with fast deployment

## Languages

- English (primary)
- Polish (native)

## Content Types

- Service descriptions
- Blog articles about AI, automation, and technology
- Case studies and implementation guides
- Technical tutorials

## Contact

For business inquiries, use the contact form on the website or reach out directly.

## Technical Stack

Built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Features server-side rendering, internationalization, and modern web standards.
